comments.note: Deliberate deviation from spec: reset() intentionally preserves $configured, $storageFile, and $clientFolder (marked 'configuration is preserved' in docblock). Resetting $configured would cause requireConfiguration() to throw in any test that calls reset() mid-test without re-calling configure(), as GeneratorTests does. All 95 tests pass with this design.
